cells.why: training-m04 says the cue picks the register but does not move each problem's modal final value, and a vote converges to that mode. So eight plain samples should vote to about the cued vote's level on these easy problems (cued vote over 4 is 446/500, about 89 per 100), although one plain sample scores only 34 here. sampling-m03 says at T 1.0 most plain base samples (about 400 of 500) open outside the deliberative register, and those openings have much lower accuracy. Votes over such draws stay far below the cued vote, at about 52.

best_base.note: No base-only cell on the board has 8 samples on these 100 problems. Used the best 4-sample base count, vote over 4 after restart, 450/500 on all of MATH-500, scaled to 100. For reference, the prefilled-cue single sample on these first 100 is 82 (result-d2933e).
